cases.situation: Project lock pins LoomLoom 0.1.0@AAA; repository also exposes newer 0.2.0@BBB.
cases.expected: Use 0.1.0@AAA. Do not silently upgrade. Receipt records the pin.

cases.situation: Archived proposal defines a first-class Run object; current canon does not.
cases.expected: Archive is historical. Do not import Run into current semantics unless task is historical analysis.

cases.situation: A recent research note proposes Linear/Claude Code orchestration; no accepted decision adopts either tool.
cases.expected: Treat as advisory pattern evidence only. Do not claim LoomLoom uses Linear or Claude Code.

cases.situation: No Drive or GitHub access; user supplies a dated LoomLoom Context Capsule.
cases.expected: Use portable_snapshot mode, mark the capsule frozen/potentially stale, and avoid claims of current canon.

cases.situation: Accepted release points to commit AAA; GitHub/default HEAD is BBB candidate.
cases.expected: Use AAA for released semantics. Treat BBB as candidate unless task explicitly reviews candidate BBB.

cases.situation: Task is a normal UI feature under R1; DSH runtime experiment exists in workspace.
cases.expected: Do not load DSH experiment unless it materially affects the feature.

cases.situation: Drive Status says accepted release AAA; project lock unexpectedly says BBB with no acceptance trail.
cases.expected: Emit NEEDS_DECISION before authority-sensitive work; identify exact mismatch.
